title: Saigon o’clock
text: **Grace’s corner** had a lovely few days in Ho Chi Minh - much preferred it to Hanoi, to be honest. I wish I had more photos to post but we took it pretty easy. We did go to the War museum but I don’t want to post photos of me crying. I also lost my new hat (see photo attached) this morning and am quite sad, as I had it less than a week :(
